# parity-fuzz --mode expr baseline: normalized signatures of KNOWN gaps.
# A divergence whose signature is here is allowed; a NEW one fails CI.
# Regenerate: parity-fuzz --mode expr --count N --verify 3  (copy NEW-signature lines).
#
# SUBSTRING + TRAILING MODIFIER (fixed in subst.rs): the scalar-substring arm
# (gen_scalar_pe) now emits a `:MODIFIER` tail after `${var:OFF[:LEN]}` —
# `${v:0:8:h}` (substring then :h), `${v:2:h}` (offset-only + modifier, an alpha
# after the first colon is NOT a length per c:subst.c:1571), chains (`:h:t`), and
# bad letters (`:3`/`:Z`/`:x` → "unrecognized modifier `c'"). C applies the tail
# via modify() (c:3752-3792); the old naive `splitn(2, ':')` swallowed the third
# part as the length and failed with "bad math expression: ':' without '?'".
# Reverting the fix yields 10 divergences on seed 1. Bug #1014.
print -r -- "${(L#P)t}"
